ns2:course.label: Text to Stage
ns2:course.description: Practical exploration of theater production for Theater majors with emphasis on the collaborative contributions of playwrights, actors, directors, designers, and dramaturges, culminating in final group projects in planning productions of one-act plays. Attendance at Department of Theater productions required. Credit not given for both THEA 101 and THEA 102. This course is required for all Theater Majors.
